第十四組期末報告

Part 3. 運用所學習到的統計學、程式設計、地圖與地理資訊系統、空間分析等方法技術，請針對學生群族，擬定台北市校園周邊健康生活計畫。

圖表分析繪製

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# 假設 park_landuse 為從 landuse_sf 篩選後的公園資料
# 過濾出「陽明山公園」多邊形
yangmingshan_poly <- park_landuse %>%
  filter(str_detect(使用分區, "陽明山公園"))  # 或使用其他辨識欄位，如使用分區 / 編號

# 計算每所學校到陽明山公園多邊形的最近距離
dist_to_yangmingshan <- st_distance(school_sf, yangmingshan_poly)

# 轉為數值並找出過近學校（小於 300 公尺）
dist_to_yangmingshan_numeric <- apply(dist_to_yangmingshan, 1, min)  # 多個面積時取最近
school_sf <- school_sf %>%
  mutate(靠近陽明山 = dist_to_yangmingshan_numeric < 300)
# 建立 500 公尺緩衝區
school_buffers <- school_sf %>% 
  st_buffer(dist = 500)

# 可視化檢查
tm_shape(school_buffers) + tm_borders(col = "blue") +
  tm_shape(school_sf) + tm_dots(size = 0.2, col = "red") +
  tm_layout(title = "學校500M緩衝區")

# 找出每所學校的緩衝區是否與任何公園相交
park_count <- st_intersects(school_buffers, park_facilities) %>% lengths()
medical_count <- st_intersects(school_buffers, medical_facilities) %>% lengths()

# 合併回學校資料
school_sf <- school_sf %>%
  mutate(
    park_count = park_count,
    medical_count = medical_count
  )
# 排序並選出前 25 筆（可視需求包含同分並列）
least_parks_sf <- school_sf %>%
  arrange(park_count) %>%
  slice_head(n = 25)

least_parks_df <- as.data.frame(least_parks_sf)

# 篩選出公園數量最少的25所學校
least_parks_sf <- school_sf %>%
  arrange(park_count) %>%
  slice_head(n = 25)

# 繪製地圖
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = VILLAGE, fill = "gray90", color = "black", size = 0.3) +  # 台北市行政區界線
  geom_sf(data = least_parks_sf, aes(color = park_count), size = 3) +              # 公園最少學校點
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", direction = -1, name = "公園數量") +
  labs(title = "台北市半徑500公尺內公園數量最少的25所學校") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16)
  )

# 計算每所學校周邊 500m / 1km 內的速食店數量
buffer_distance <- 1000  # 1km 範圍
school_buffers <- st_buffer(school_sf, buffer_distance)

school_sf$fastfood_count <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(school_buffers)), function(i) {
  sum(st_intersects(school_buffers[i, ], fastfood, sparse = FALSE))
})

# 找出速食店最多的學校 (前10名)
top_schools <- school_sf %>%
  arrange(desc(fastfood_count)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

print(top_schools[, c("Name", "fastfood_count")])

# 進行K、G、F 函數分析
# 轉換成 spatstat 格式
school_ppp <- as.ppp(st_coordinates(school_sf), owin(range(st_coordinates(school_sf)[,1]), range(st_coordinates(school_sf)[,2])))
fastfood_ppp <- as.ppp(st_coordinates(fastfood), owin(range(st_coordinates(fastfood)[,1]), range(st_coordinates(fastfood)[,2])))
## Warning: data contain duplicated points
K_school <- Kest(school_ppp)
G_school <- Gest(school_ppp)
F_school <- Fest(school_ppp)

K_fastfood <- Kest(fastfood_ppp)
G_fastfood <- Gest(fastfood_ppp)
F_fastfood <- Fest(fastfood_ppp)

# 可視化學校周邊速食店密度
ggplot(school_sf, aes(x = fastfood_count)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "blue", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "學校周邊速食店數量分布", x = "速食店數量", y = "學校數") +
  theme_minimal()

# 計算每所學校周邊 500m / 1km 內的速食店數量
buffer_distance <- 1000  # 1km 範圍
school_buffers <- st_buffer(school_sf, buffer_distance)

school$fastfood_count <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(school_buffers)), function(i) {
  sum(st_intersects(school_buffers[i, ], fastfood, sparse = FALSE))
})

school_stats <- school_sf

# 找出速食店最多的前 10 所學校
top_schools <- school_sf %>%
  arrange(desc(fastfood_count)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

# Coordinates
school_coords <- st_coordinates(school_sf)
fastfood_coords <- st_coordinates(fastfood)

# 定義owin空間窗口
xrange <- range(c(school_coords[,1], fastfood_coords[,1]))
yrange <- range(c(school_coords[,2], fastfood_coords[,2]))
win <- owin(xrange, yrange)

school_ppp <- as.ppp(school_coords, W = win)
fastfood_ppp <- as.ppp(fastfood_coords, W = win)
## Warning: data contain duplicated points
K_school <- Kest(school_ppp)
G_school <- Gest(school_ppp)
F_school <- Fest(school_ppp)

K_fastfood <- Kest(fastfood_ppp)
G_fastfood <- Gest(fastfood_ppp)
F_fastfood <- Fest(fastfood_ppp)

# 地圖視覺化

# 5-1: 繪製速食店最多的前10所學校位置
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = VILLAGE, fill = "gray90", color = "black", size = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = top_schools, aes(color = fastfood_count), size = 3) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", direction = -1, name = "速食店數量") +
  labs(title = "台北市速食店數量最多的前10所學校（1公里範圍內）") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16)
  )

# 5-2: 所有學校速食店分布（點大小代表數量）
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = school_stats, aes(size = fastfood_count, color = fastfood_count), alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "速食店數量") +
  scale_size(range = c(1, 10), name = "速食店數量") +
  labs(title = "各學校 1 公里內的速食店數量") +
  theme_minimal()

# 5-3: 直方圖
ggplot(school_stats, aes(x = fastfood_count)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "各學校 1 公里內的速食店數量分布",
    x = "速食店數量",
    y = "學校數量"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

library(sf)
library(dplyr)

top_n <- 5

# 計算距離矩陣
distance_matrix <- st_distance(school_sf, park_facilities)
distance_numeric <- as.matrix(distance_matrix)

# 取得最近5個公園的 index
nearest_park_indexes <- apply(distance_numeric, 1, function(row) {
  order(row)[1:top_n]
})

# 初始化列表用來存儲資訊
nearest_park_ids <- list()
nearest_park_coords_x <- list()
nearest_park_coords_y <- list()

# 逐校紀錄
for (i in seq_len(nrow(school_sf))) {
  indexes <- nearest_park_indexes[, i]
  nearest_park_ids[[i]] <- park_facilities$編號[indexes]
  
  coords <- st_coordinates(park_facilities[indexes, ])
  nearest_park_coords_x[[i]] <- coords[, 1]
  nearest_park_coords_y[[i]] <- coords[, 2]
}

# 整理為資料框
nearest_park_ids_df <- do.call(rbind, nearest_park_ids) %>% as.data.frame()
colnames(nearest_park_ids_df) <- paste0("nearest_park_", 1:top_n, "_id")

nearest_park_x_df <- do.call(rbind, nearest_park_coords_x) %>% as.data.frame()
## Warning in (function (..., deparse.level = 1) : number of columns of result is
## not a multiple of vector length (arg 1)
colnames(nearest_park_x_df) <- paste0("nearest_park_", 1:top_n, "_x")

nearest_park_y_df <- do.call(rbind, nearest_park_coords_y) %>% as.data.frame()
## Warning in (function (..., deparse.level = 1) : number of columns of result is
## not a multiple of vector length (arg 1)
colnames(nearest_park_y_df) <- paste0("nearest_park_", 1:top_n, "_y")

# 距離也整理
nearest_park_dists <- t(apply(distance_numeric, 1, function(row) {
  sort(row, partial = 1:top_n)[1:top_n]
}))
nearest_park_dists_df <- as.data.frame(nearest_park_dists)
colnames(nearest_park_dists_df) <- paste0("distance_to_park_", 1:top_n)

# 檢查原 sf 是否已包含這些欄位，若有重名則先移除
cols_to_remove <- intersect(names(school_sf), c(
  colnames(nearest_park_ids_df),
  colnames(nearest_park_dists_df),
  colnames(nearest_park_x_df),
  colnames(nearest_park_y_df)
))
school_sf <- school_sf %>% select(-all_of(cols_to_remove))

# 合併所有資訊
school_sf <- bind_cols(
  school_sf,
  nearest_park_ids_df,
  nearest_park_dists_df,
  nearest_park_x_df,
  nearest_park_y_df
)

#包含離陽明山國家公園較近的國小
# 1. 整理距離資料
distance_df <- school_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(Name,
         distance_to_park_1,
         distance_to_park_2,
         distance_to_park_3,
         distance_to_park_4,
         distance_to_park_5) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("distance_to_park_"),
    names_to = "k_order",
    values_to = "distance"
  ) %>%
  mutate(k = as.numeric(gsub("distance_to_park_", "", k_order)))

# 2. 使用 Tukey’s Rule 計算離群值閾值
distance_outlier_info <- distance_df %>%
  group_by(k) %>%
  summarise(
    Q1 = quantile(distance, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(distance, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR = Q3 - Q1,
    upper = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR
  )

# 3. 加入是否為離群值的標註
distance_df <- distance_df %>%
  left_join(distance_outlier_info, by = "k") %>%
  mutate(outlier = distance > upper)

# 4. 繪圖：K-order Nearest Neighbor Distance 曲線
ggplot(distance_df, aes(x = k, y = distance, group = Name)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5, color = "gray") +
  geom_point(aes(color = outlier), size = 2) +
  geom_text(data = filter(distance_df, outlier),
            aes(label = Name),
            size = 3, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "red")) +
  labs(
    title = "K-order Nearest Park Distance per School",
    x = "K-th Nearest Park",
    y = "Distance (m)",
    color = "Outlier"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# === 1. 找出第1或第5近公園為離群的學校名稱 ===
outlier_names <- distance_df %>%
  filter(k %in% c(1, 5), outlier == TRUE) %>%
  pull(Name) %>%
  unique()

# === 2. 取得第1與第5距離資訊 ===
outlier_distances <- distance_df %>%
  filter(Name %in% outlier_names, k %in% c(1, 5)) %>%
  select(Name, k, distance) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = k, names_prefix = "k", values_from = distance)

# === 3. 合併到學校資料 ===
outlier_school_sf <- school_sf %>%
  filter(Name %in% outlier_names, 靠近陽明山 == FALSE) %>%
  left_join(outlier_distances, by = "Name")

# === 4. 建立以第1近與第5近距離為半徑的緩衝區 ===
buffer_k1 <- st_buffer(outlier_school_sf, dist = outlier_school_sf$k1)
buffer_k5 <- st_buffer(outlier_school_sf, dist = outlier_school_sf$k5)

# 加入標記以便辨識是哪種緩衝區
buffer_k1$type <- "1st Nearest"
buffer_k5$type <- "5th Nearest"

# 合併兩種緩衝區資料
school_buffers <- rbind(buffer_k1, buffer_k5)

# === 5. 繪圖 ===
library(ggrepel)  # 用來美化標籤（可選）
## Warning: 套件 'ggrepel' 是用 R 版本 4.4.3 來建造的
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = park_facilities, color = "lightgray", size = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = school_sf, color = "gray", shape = 1) +
  geom_sf(data = outlier_school_sf, color = "red", size = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = school_buffers, aes(linetype = type), fill = NA, color = "red") +
  
  # 標示離群學校名稱
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = outlier_school_sf,
    aes(geometry = geometry, label = Name),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    min.segment.length = 0,
    size = 4,
    color = "red"
  ) +

  labs(title = "Buffers for 1st and 5th Nearest Parks of Outlier Schools",
       linetype = "Buffer Type") +
  theme_minimal()

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(leaflet)

# 假設 outlier_schools_sf 已經有了
# 轉成經緯度系統 (WGS84)
schools_wgs <- st_transform(outlier_school_sf, 4326)

# 建立緩衝區 (例如半徑 1000 公尺)
# 注意：經緯度單位是度，不適合直接用於距離
# 所以先轉成公尺單位的投影系統 (例如EPSG:3857)，做buffer，再轉回4326
schools_proj <- st_transform(schools_wgs, 3857)

buffer_radius <- 500  # 公尺
schools_buffer <- st_buffer(schools_proj, dist = buffer_radius)

# 再轉回經緯度
schools_buffer_wgs <- st_transform(schools_buffer, 4326)

# Leaflet 地圖繪製
leaflet() %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addPolygons(data = schools_buffer_wgs,
              color = "blue", weight = 2, fill = TRUE, fillOpacity = 0.2,
              popup = ~schools_wgs$Name) %>%
  addMarkers(data = schools_wgs,
             lng = ~st_coordinates(geometry)[,1],
             lat = ~st_coordinates(geometry)[,2],
             popup = ~Name)
